newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Twenty injured after Bangladesh train car derails.
newsitem.headline: Twenty injured after Bangladesh train car derails.

text.p: At least 20 people were injured on Thursday when a packed coach of an express train jumped the tracks 80 km (50 miles) from the port city of Chittagong, railway officials said.
The officials said the victims were injured trying to jump out of train doors and windows.
Thousands travelling to and from Chittagong ahead of the Moslem Eid al-Fitr festival were stranded for more than 10 hours after the derailment halted other trains.
"Train services will be resumed sometime tonight," one railway official said, without giving the cause of the accident.
